description: This file defines a static class 'UnhandledCodeGenerationExceptionDiagnostic' that provides diagnostics for unhandled exceptions during source code generation in the Orleans project. It includes constants for rule identification, descriptive strings for diagnostics, and a method to create diagnostic instances from exceptions.

classes.name: UnhandledCodeGenerationExceptionDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic definitions and a method to generate diagnostics for unhandled source generation exceptions.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object based on a caught Exception, with diagnostic details for reporting.
